_about: Public-domain James Freeman Clarke (1810-1888), Unitarian minister of the Church of the Disciples, Boston, for the Word Hoard: Eleven Weeks in Europe (1852), The Christian Doctrine of Prayer (1854), The Hour which Cometh (1864), Orthodoxy: its Truths and Errors (1866), Steps of Belief (1870), The Christian Doctrine of Forgiveness of Sin (1870), Go Up Higher (1877), Essentials and Non-Essentials in Religion (1878), Memorial and Biographical Sketches (1878), Ten Great Religions (1878 printing), Self-Culture (1880) and Anti-Slavery Days (1884 catalogued 1880). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 64 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
